description: Ten build-stream events (qa_scope, step_usage, gate_tier_result/failed/summary, test_review, health_score, capability_violation, idea_suggestion, buildStreamEvent) are broadcast to the agent SSE stream but dropped by the desktop renderer (build-stream-bridge -> MessageCard.jsx:318).
